content: Education Portal: multi-tenant school portal, .NET 10 + Angular 22 + PostgreSQL, Clean Architecture, hosted by Aspire. AGENTS.md is the source of truth; base branch is development. AGENTS.md section 7 rule 11: use Ruflo memory on every task (search before, store after, namespace education-portal). Ruflo mission msn_ea7e2d9e8ee7bca277c2fc89 was cancelled 2026-11-21 before any work ran. Hooks are project level (.claude/helpers is git-ignored runtime state; restore from git history ef10f18^ if missing).

Research t1 (2026-11-21), verified in code. AuthorizationBehaviour checks module with campusId:null always, then IRoleRights.HasRightAsync(userId, schoolId, module, right); Administrators and master skip rights. RolePermission has CanView/Create/Edit/Delete/Approve/Export, no CampusId, no ViewHistory; AccessRight enum has None..Export(6), so ViewHistory = 7. ICampusAccess (EnsureCampusAsync, GetAllowedCampusIdsAsync) limits by UserCampus only, not role-campus. SchoolRole is BaseAuditableEntity (hard delete), IsSystem for built-ins. ChangeAuditInterceptor.AuditedTypes holds only commercial types (ADR-016); GET /api/ChangeAudit exists (Web/Endpoints/ChangeAudit.cs, Application/Audit). Angular: navigation.ts uses access 'school-administrator' + module; auth.guards.ts has moduleGuard and administrator guards, no rights service. Existing denial tests: tests/Application.FunctionalTests/SchoolRoles/{RoleRightsTests,CampusAccessTests}.cs, Tenancy/TenantIsolationModelTests.cs, Application.UnitTests/Common/Behaviours/{ModuleAuthorization,RoleRightsAuthorization}Tests.cs. ADRs to extend: 012, 016, 018 (new ADR-021 for Tenant level, ADR-020 is the latest). Migrations are regenerated, never merged by hand.

User decision 2026-11-21 (final): RolePermission.CampusId is REQUIRED (non-null) plus bool AllCampuses (true = every campus, ignores CampusId). Old rows backfilled AllCampuses=true and the school's MAIN campus. Every school already has exactly one main campus (School.Create -> Campus.CreateMain, CampusKind.Main, unique IX_Campuses_SingleMainPerSchool, not deletable via DeleteCampus). Spec: docs/specs/rights-tenants-history-calendar.md.

2026-11-21 maintainer chose ADR-021 option B: new Tenant entity owns Subscription, TenantModule, invoices, country, data region, tax override, IsMaster (unique index); School keeps domain, branding, campuses, roles, ITenantOwned data; School.TenantId required; several schools per tenant; only master domain runs AddSchoolToTenant; migration = one tenant per existing school. Open: tenant administrator role (default none). ADR file: docs/decisions/ADR-021-Tenant-Above-School.md.

2026-11-21 maintainer: tenant administrator = the Administrator account created at school registration (public Register screen or master add); no new role. Master tenant needs an edit screen per tenant with all register-screen options plus master-only ones. Domain is set only by master when editing a school; a school with a domain cannot sign in on the master domain (matches ADR-020, needs a test). Recorded in ADR-021 and spec R2.7-R2.9.

2026-11-21: ADR-021 tenant, ADR-022 per-campus rights (+ViewHistory), ADR-023 readable history (personal-data values hidden), ADR-024 users+roles screen/create rule/soft delete written under docs/decisions; SOP at docs/sop/rights-tenants-history.md. New ADRs make readme-guard and architecture-diagram-guard demand README + diagram updates in the PR.

2026-11-21 t6: phase 1 failing tests exist (RolePermissionCampusTests, CampusSetsTests, RoleRightsPerCampusTests). Red = compile errors for missing API: RolePermission.Create(role,module,campus,allCampuses,view,create,edit,delete,approve,export,viewHistory), Set(...,viewHistory), CampusId/AllCampuses/CanViewHistory, AccessRight.ViewHistory=7, Application.Campuses.Common.CampusSets.Intersect(a,b), IRoleRights.GetRightCampusIdsAsync. Existing 8-arg RolePermission.Create callers (SchoolRoleTests, RoleRightsTests, handlers) must be updated in t7. Still to write in t7: ICampusAccess overload tests, GetMyRights, Angular specs.

t7 partly done, NOT complete. Done: C# domain (ViewHistory=7, RolePermission CampusId+AllCampuses+CanViewHistory), CampusSets, IRoleRights.GetRightCampusIdsAsync, ICampusAccess campus+module overloads, GET /api/Users/me/rights (GetMyRights), built-in roles ViewHistory; dotnet build OK; Domain 614/614 and Application.UnitTests 463/463 pass. Angular: rights.service.ts (can/load/clear), rightsGuard, navigation right check (optional RightCheck param), sidebar wired, AuthService loads rights, generated client updated by hand (getMyRights + DTOs). ng build OK; ng test 310 pass, 5 fail in schools.page.spec and campuses.page.spec (files untouched by me, not verified on clean checkout). Specs for login/change-password flush /api/Users/me/rights. NOT done: EF migration (user will flatten and regenerate later), functional tests (Docker down), ICampusAccess overload unit tests, GetMyRights tests, regenerate NSwag client properly. Mission task t7 left open.

2026-11-21: 5 Angular specs fail on committed HEAD too (not caused by phase 1). schools.page.spec.ts x4: expects pageSize=25, page sends 100. campuses.page.spec.ts x1: expects street address text the page does not render. Accepted for phase 1 PR as known failures; fix in a separate PR. Verified by a worktree run of HEAD.
